input_contract.diagnostics: object (the diagnostics Orb output: os, disk[], memory, temp_files, drivers, security, startup, ...)

output_contract.description: EXACTLY two shapes. There is deliberately NO shape for a heuristic plan under status:ok — that absence is the structural kill for Manifest I2. The orchestrator MUST branch on status.

actions.id: string (MUST be in the repair-engine catalogue)

oneOf.reason: string (why no model could author a plan)

observation_contract.description: Events the orchestrator and (later) the Custodian stage may observe. The stage may show an 'authoring' worker only while plan.requested is open, and must reflect plan.unavailable honestly — never pantomime a plan that was not authored.

evidence_contract.description: Each ok plan carries provenance (provider+model) as its evidence of authorship. certification_preflight.check_ai_repair_plan is the executable check that the plan references diagnostics and is not the canned fallback string.

envelope_ref.description: This Umbilical is KEYED to the action envelope by the Orchestrator. The Orchestrator holds the envelope, hash-checks this ref at attach (a mismatch fails the attach), compiles the per-machine admissible action set from envelope preconditions x live diagnostics, hands only that narrowed set to the attached author (cloud Orb OR local-model Satellite), and validates the returned plan against the envelope before advancing to consent. The rules below are the envelope's consequences, not an independent copy.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: Enforced by the Orchestrator via the keyed envelope, identically for the cloud author and the local-model Satellite: (1) Missing/invalid diagnostics -> status:unavailable ('insufficient diagnostics'). (2) All providers fail -> status:unavailable. (3) An action id outside the repair-engine catalogue, or whose envelope precondition is FALSE on this machine, or missing a required_param -> dropped and logged, never passed to the engine. (4) risk and requires_restart are taken from the envelope, never from model output. (5) estimated_mb_recovered is clamped to the envelope mb bound; the plan total may not exceed measured reclaimable space. (6) At most plan_bounds.max_actions actions; subsumed members dropped when their umbrella is present.
